note: The void's open ground (trailer.md, The Crystal Cut; neon-look.md, The Trailer): the look's world kit as a layout, for the crystal cut's shots to play on. Nothing blocks on it, so the horde never parts round anything the void doesn't draw; a shot's crystal formations are its only obstacles, and the only set pieces (the style guide: crystal is the one material). 160 m square like the arena, so the simulation's spawns and fields work as on it; one named area, the camp at the centre, where the hook's duel stands. A trailer shot names it as its layout ("layout": "void"); the shot's environment then only lends its resident scene, whose whole set the void hides.
name: void
